global: A steaming bowl of miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth. Topped with shredded green onions and bean sprouts, it sits in a white ceramic bowl against a dark wooden table, illuminated by warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, smooth surface, and subtle red mark on rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with shredded green onions and cabbage, appears rich, golden-brown, and glossy.
